verdicts.tldr: No test fails if a 0-fee tx's gas cap follows gas-wanted instead of MaxGasCreditPerTx: the PR's txtar asks for exactly the 10M window and asserts only 'out of gas'
verdicts.details: At head, ante.go:122 caps the 0-fee meter at the window. A 100M gas-wanted call stops at 10000139 gas, so the code is right. Mutating that line to SetGasMeter(ctx, tx.Fee.GasWanted) makes the same call burn 919232627 gas, which nobody pays for. paygas_credit_exhausted stays green under the mutation because it sends -gas-wanted 10000000 and checks stderr 'out of gas' only, never where the meter stopped. This is a coverage gap on correct code, not a defect, so it is Missing test rather than Warning. Fix: send -gas-wanted above the window (e.g. 100000000) in paygas_credit_exhausted.txtar and assert stdout 'GAS USED:   100[0-9]{5}$'.
verdicts.evidence: head, finder txtar: 'GAS WANTED: 100000000' / 'GAS USED:   10000139' / '--- PASS: TestTestdata/b5_credit_above_gas_wanted'. Mutated ante.go:122: 'GAS USED:   919232627', 'FAIL: testdata/b5_credit_above_gas_wanted.txtar:30: no match for `GAS USED:   100[0-9]{5}$`', and '--- PASS: TestTestdata/paygas_credit_exhausted (0.89s)' even though that run also reported 'GAS WANTED: 10000000' / 'GAS USED:   919232627'. Base: no credit window and no fixture, so there is nothing to compare.
verdicts.verify_by: Run tests/b5-lines-reach-catalog-credit-above-gas-wanted.txtar (gas-wanted 100M, asserts `GAS USED:   100[0-9]{5}$`): PASS at head. sed ante.go `SetGasMeter(ctx, consParams.Block.MaxGasCreditPerTx)` -> `SetGasMeter(ctx, tx.Fee.GasWanted)`: the probe FAILs and TestTestdata/paygas_credit_exhausted still PASSes.

verdicts.tldr: gnogenesis verify now passes a genesis with a zero-fee tx that a default node (window closed) panics on at InitChain; master refused it
verdicts.details: Under the PR, tx.go:55 accepts the empty Coin as a fee. contribs/gnogenesis/internal/verify/verify.go:94 checks genesis txs only through tx.Tx.ValidateBasic(), so it now passes a zero-fee genesis tx. The node rejects that tx in the ante at ante.go:166 when Block.MaxGasCreditPerTx is 0, which is the default. gnoland start leaves --skip-failing-genesis-txs at false by default, so NewApp keeps PanicOnFailingTxResultHandler and InitChain panics. So a genesis that verify approves cannot boot a node on a chain that never opted into sponsorship, and at base verify caught it. Fix: in verify.go, reject a zero-fee genesis tx when genesis.ConsensusParams.Block.MaxGasCreditPerTx == 0, the same rule ante.go:166 applies.

"zero-fee transactions require a non-zero Block.MaxGasCreditPerTx"'. start.go:91 'skip-failing-genesis-txs', default false; app.go:391 'GenesisTxResultHandler: PanicOnFailingTxResultHandler'. base 3cc494ec4, same test without the MaxGasCreditPerTx line, which does not compile there: 'tx.ValidateBasic() = insufficient fee error', 'gnogenesis verify error = invalid transacton, insufficient fee error', '--- FAIL'.
